# trustee

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:trustee`](gmeow-trustee.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/trustee>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/trust`](../../slices/trust.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The agent that is trusted by the trustor in a trust-assertion.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:TrustAssertion`](../classes/gmeow-TrustAssertion.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); functional

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:TrustAssertion`](../classes/gmeow-TrustAssertion.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the agent that is trusted in a trust assertion — the trustee the trustor vouches for or designates as an introducer.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the perspective holder (that is [`gmeow:trustor`](gmeow-trustor.md)) and avoid reading a trustee's being trusted as a global fact — it holds only from this trustor's standpoint. It is functional — one trustee per assertion.

### How to use

- Bind exactly one [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) as the trustee; record the degree with [`gmeow:trustLevel`](gmeow-trustLevel.md) and any introducer parameters on the same relator, and let competing trustors' assessments of the same trustee coexist.

### Examples

- ex:t1 [`gmeow:trustee`](gmeow-trustee.md) ex:bob.
